name: Dragon Gold 88

features.name: Scatter nudge respin
features.description: Two scatters lock and respin for a third.

features.name: Up to 20 free spins
features.description: Triggered by three or more scatters.

review:
A 10-line Asian game among icy mountains, with turtles, frogs and fish. Three scatters give up to 20 free spins – and if only two land, they nudge down, lock and give you a respin for the third, which takes the sting out of near misses.

Before the bonus you can add modifiers like extra money symbols, more dragons, two extra spins or a higher starting level, much like recent Big Bass games. High 96.71% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
